lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow vertical gradient running from the post-cranial region towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs is visible within the mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, lower-intensity spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary lateral flank blobs.
